item.title: Gran Turismo 7 Daily Races: No Sugo for You
item.description: Sugo may be the track everyone wants to drive.
item.content:encoded:
A new week brings a new set of Gran Turismo 7 Daily Races, with three fresh events now live and running through next Monday, October 26.

In its place, Race A heads to Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve for a five-lap one-make in the Ferrari Enzo Ferrari ’02. Here it runs on Sports Soft tires with BOP (L), a rolling start, and settings fully fixed.

Race B is a straightforward six laps of Autodromo de Interlagos in Gr.3 cars on Racing Hard tires, with BOP (M), a rolling start, and brake balance the only open setting.

Race C is the longest and most involved event of the week. It’s eleven laps of Suzuka’s figure-eight layout in the full 2016 Super GT GT500 lineup, with fuel use doubled and tire wear at 4x. Racing Mediums are the only compound available, and a single pit stop is mandatory.

GT7 Daily Races (October 19): Race A

  • Track: Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve (5 laps)
  • Car: Ferrari Enzo Ferrari ’02 — Event-Specified
  • Power/Weight/PP Limit: BOP (L)
  • Tires: Sports Soft
  • Settings: Specified
  • Start Type: Rolling Start
  • Mandatory Pit Stop: –
  • Fuel Multiplier: 1x
  • Tire Multiplier: 1x

GT7 Daily Races (October 19): Race B

  • Track: Autodromo de Interlagos (6 laps)
  • Car: Gr.3 — Garage/Specified Car
  • Power/Weight/PP Limit: BOP (M)
  • Tires: Racing Hard
  • Settings: Partially Allowed (Brake Balance)
  • Start Type: Rolling Start
  • Mandatory Pit Stop: –
  • Fuel Multiplier: 1x
  • Tire Multiplier: 1x

GT7 Daily Races (October 19): Race C

  • Track: Suzuka Circuit (11 laps)
  • Car: Nissan GT-R NISMO GT500 ’16, Honda NSX CONCEPT-GT ’16, Lexus RC F GT500 ’16 — Garage/Specified Car
  • Power/Weight/PP Limit: BOP (M)
  • Tires: Racing Medium
  • Settings: Partially Allowed (Brake Balance)
  • Start Type: Rolling Start
  • Mandatory Pit Stop: 1
  • Fuel Multiplier: 2x
  • Tire Multiplier: 4x

With GT7’s Daily Races rolling over every Monday, the next new set should land on Monday, October 26.
